verses.english: “Reverend Koṭṭhita, they speak of this thing called ‘ignorance’.
And how is an ignoramus defined?”

verses.pali: “Idhāvuso, assutavā puthujjano rūpassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: “Reverend, an unlearned ordinary person doesn’t truly understand the origin, the disappearance, the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to form,

verses.pali: viññāṇassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.

verses.english: And this is how an ignoramus is defined.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṁ mahākoṭṭhikaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Venerable Sāriputta said to him:
“Reverend Koṭṭhita, they speak of this thing called ‘knowledge’.
And how is a knowing one defined?”

verses.pali: “Idhāvuso, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: “Reverend, a learned noble disciple truly understands the origin, the disappearance, the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to form,

verses.pali: viññāṇassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.

verses.english: And this is how a knowing one is defined.”
